messages:
Sam R: Quick heads-up — change window starts at 14:00 UTC (in 30m). Can we run the silent prelaunch checklist now?
Maya L: Yep. I'm kicking off smoke suite against staging. Will post results in ~5.
Aisha K: I'll pin inference-runtime to v3.4.2 for the window. Leaving config to canary only.
Ben P: What's the canary traffic split? 5%? 10%?
Maya L: 5% for first 10m, monitor errors and latency, then 25% if green.
Carol J: Release notes are ready in the docs repo, link: https://git.internal/releases/3.4.2 — approved.
devops-oncall: FYI I've verified the rollback playbook is staged and tested. Runbook: /runbooks/rollback-inference.md
Sam R: Good. Aisha, run the pin command when you're ready. Remember to set sticky=true so deploy-bot retains version on rollbacks.
Aisha K: Running now: `deploy-bot pin inference-runtime v3.4.2 --sticky true`
deploy-bot: [system] Pin request accepted for inference-runtime -> v3.4.2. Pin ID: pin-20260321-07
Maya L: Smoke tests initial results: CPU and mem look fine. Latency within expected 95th p50. Pushing canary at 5%.
Maya L: `deploy-bot rollout inference-runtime canary --percent 5 --version v3.4.2`
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: inference-runtime v3.4.2 -> 5% traffic. Canary ID: c-9876
Ben P: Observability hooks in place? Traces and token-cost metric?
Maya L: Yep. Dashboards: /dashboards/inference/latency, /dashboards/inference/errors, /dashboards/inference/costs
Aisha K: quick sanity check: integrated KV cache defaults preserved in this build?
Maya L: Confirmed, kv-cache enabled and warmup script ran.
devops-oncall: Alert thresholds set: 5xx rate >0.8% OR p95 latency +200ms => auto-rollback.
Sam R: Great. Keep a close eye for any unusual allocation spikes in dedicated pools.
Maya L: Canary steady at 5% for 12m, errors 0.02%, p95 +20ms. Proceeding to 25%.
Maya L: `deploy-bot rollout inference-runtime canary --percent 25 --canary-id c-9876`
deploy-bot: Canary update: 25% traffic. Monitoring...
Ben P: Noticing slight token cost increase in sampler route, looks expected. Flagging for Optimize team post-launch.
Carol J: Ops note: customer-impacting endpoints documented in the release notes under Known Issues.
Maya L: 25% stable for 8m. No alerts. Ready for staged shift to 50% over next 5m.
Aisha K: Reminder: if rollback occurs, run the warmup after rollback to rehydrate cache: `./scripts/warmup-cache.sh --target inference-runtime`
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary metrics exceeded threshold — 5xx rate = 1.2% over 3m window. Initiating automatic rollback per policy.
Maya L: Copy that, stopping further rollout.
Ben P: Confirm rollback and check if any downstream queues spiked.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Inference-runtime reverted to v3.4.1. Pin ID pin-20260321-06 restored.
devops-oncall: Verified traffic rolled back. No customer-impacting errors discovered in logs except one worker OOM on node gpu-11. Taking node out of rotation for postmortem.
Sam R: Good call. We'll abort the change window for this component until root cause fixed. Marking change window as partial-failure; notify stakeholders.
Carol J: Posting update to #general and the release notes page: "Canary triggered rollback due to elevated 5xx; rollout paused. Investigating OOM on gpu-11."
Aisha K: Will open a bug, assign to infra. Title: "OOM on gpu-11 during v3.4.2 canary".
Ben P: Reverting any pin overrides we made? Looks like deploy-bot restored previous pin.
Maya L: Yes, deploy-bot restored previous pin. I'll create a follow-up checklist for a second attempt: increased memory limit, extra warmup, smaller canary increments.
Sam R: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after postmortem and a remediation plan. :thumbsup:
Carol J: Acknowledged. I'll mark the release as "paused" in the tracker and notify sales ops.
Maya L: Attaching logs: ```
[2026-03-21T14:15:12Z] gpu-11 OOM kill pid 22345
[2026-03-21T14:16:05Z] deploy-bot rollback initiated canary c-9876
[2026-03-21T14:16:30Z] rollback complete, traffic restored
```
Sam R: Closing thread for now. We'll open a new prerelease thread once infra patches applied.
